info.title: Crumbs API
info.description: Cookieless analytics on a Cloud Engine. Base URL is your native backend HTTPS origin (or optional Node collector). Report/resource integers from Candid are decimal strings; collection acknowledgments and collector-health counters are JSON numbers. Native acceptance commits directly to the canister; Node acceptance confirms a local queue. Native mode requires stable event IDs and has no GeoIP. Native raw HTTP requests including IP/UA enter replicated processing but are excluded from persisted analytics event fields. Sending an event requires a registered website, not a secret browser key. Public collection is not proof of a human visitor. Report credentials are always server-side authorized. UTC day/hour buckets and rotating daily visitor estimates; see metric definitions. Query/auth credentials do not grant the signed collector lane.
